lessons.title: Intro
lessons.interactiveContent:
Sometimes we want to apply the same properties across multiple elements. Like setting the same font-family for all buttons and paragraphs.

Make sure to pick font-family: Courier New;, followed by font-family: Courier New;.
lessons.hardModeContent:
The paragraph and button use the same typeface. Identify the matching declaration in both separate rules.

Make sure to pick font-family: Courier New;, followed by font-family: Courier New;.

lessons.title: Comma
lessons.interactiveContent:
Instead of writing a new rule for each element, we can use a comma to style <p> and <button> elements using the same rule.

Make sure to pick ,, followed by button.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Instead of writing a new rule for each element, we can use a comma to style <p> and <button> elements using the same rule.

Use tag selectors to give the paragraph and button the Courier New typeface.

Make sure to pick p, button, followed by font-family.

lessons.title: Grouping selector
lessons.interactiveContent:
p, button is called a grouping selector since it groups different elements under one rule.

Make sure to pick p, button.
lessons.hardModeContent:
p, button is called a grouping selector since it groups different elements under one rule.

Select both elements that need this shared typeface.

Make sure to pick p, button.

lessons.title: Classes
lessons.interactiveContent:
We can add selectors of any type. For example, we can use the .offer class selector instead of the button selector.

Make sure to pick ,, followed by .offer.
lessons.hardModeContent:
We can add selectors of any type. Group the paragraph with the button that has the offer class.

Make sure to pick ,, followed by .offer.

lessons.title: As many as we want
lessons.interactiveContent:
We can add as many selectors as we want. Try adding another by coding , h2.

Make sure to pick ,, followed by h2.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You can add as many selectors as you need to a grouping selector.

The heading should share the typeface already used by the paragraph and offer button. Add it as a third selector.

Make sure to pick ,, followed by h2.

lessons.title: Question: Comma
lessons.interactiveContent:
What are grouping selectors for?

Styling multiple elements with the same ruleStyling a specific element with a rule

Styling multiple elements with the same rule.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A paragraph, button, and heading need the same font family. What CSS feature avoids repeating the declaration?

A grouping selectorA separate rule for every elementA class only on the heading

Make sure to pick A grouping selector.

lessons.title: Question: Grouping selector
lessons.interactiveContent:
How do we create a grouping selector?

By adding multiple selectors separated by a commaBy adding multiple selectors separated by a space

By adding multiple selectors separated by a comma.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You want one rule to target p and button. What goes between the two selectors?

A commaA spaceA semicolon

Make sure to pick A comma.

lessons.title: Question: Classes
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which type of selector can we group together?

We can group any kind of selectors togetherOnly HTML element selectors

We can group any kind of selectors together.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Can one grouping selector combine p with .offer?

Yes, it can combine different selector types.No, it can combine only element selectors.No, class selectors need their own rule.

Yes, it can combine different selector types.

lessons.title: Question: As many as we want
lessons.interactiveContent:
What's wrong with this code?

Commas should separate selectors, not semicolonsThere are too many selectors

Commas should separate selectors, not semicolons.
lessons.hardModeContent:
The rule is meant to make the heading, main story, and paragraphs bold. Which character prevents it from being a valid selector group?

The semicolon after h2The comma after .mainstoryThe colon after font-weight

Make sure to pick The semicolon after h2.

lessons.title: Example: Comma
lessons.interactiveContent:
Add a grouping selector for h2, h5, and button.

Make sure to pick h2, h5, button.
lessons.hardModeContent:
The course title, subtitle, and button need Courier New, while the site title stays Helvetica.

Write a selector group that selects only those three elements.

Make sure to pick h2, h5, button.

lessons.title: Example: Grouping selector
lessons.interactiveContent:
Create a grouping selector with a heading and an image by coding a comma, followed by the img selector.

Make sure to pick ,, followed by img.
lessons.hardModeContent:
The travel subtitle and photo should both be half the page width. Complete one grouping selector that targets those two elements.

Make sure to pick ,, followed by img.

lessons.title: Example: Classes
lessons.interactiveContent:
To style elements of the theme CSS class in the same rule, add .theme to the group selector.

Make sure to type .theme.
